scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mini-agent-run/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@mini-agent-run/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace=@mini-agent-run/server && npm run build --workspace=@mini-agent-run/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently --kill-others -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@mini-agent-run/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@mini-agent-run/web"
